title: During barn
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：during　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 during 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the baker kept the tray ① during the long winter at the oven, and everybody in the bakery said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: the tray had been left ② during the night in the barn, and nobody had asked a single question. The baker had come to the bakery two weeks earlier and spoke little of the bakery he had left behind him.

The bill for December 1951 puts it plainer. It was done ③ during the silence after supper, and the customer who kept the tray had tasted it ④ during the watch of the old nurse twice before the winter came; nothing in the bakery was ever done during the silence after supper in those days. The customer wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the tray at the far oven, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ during the storm, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ during the absence of the men; he was not a man who explained himself, and the bakery had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1964 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the bill. What the line asked for was that the tray be tasted ⑦ during the whole journey, and that the names be written ⑧ during the meeting of the council. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried during the whole journey.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1967 she kept the tray ⑨ during the long winter again when nobody else would, and ⑩ during the night in the barn, she said in 1969, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the tray in the same oven for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the bakery never forgot what had been done during the night in the barn.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 在…期间（表时间：during the long winter）
B. prep. 在…期间（表处所：during the night in the barn）
C. prep. 在…期间（表方式／状态：during the silence after supper）
D. prep. 在…期间（引出施动者或相关的人：be tasted during the watch of the old nurse）
E. prep. 在…期间（表原因：during the storm）
F. prep. 在…期间（表对象／目的：during the absence of the men）
G. prep. 在…期间（表工具／材料：during the whole journey）
H. prep. 在…期间（表载体／处所：written during the meeting of the council）

items.q: during the night in the barn
during the watch of the old nurse
during the absence of the men
during the meeting of the council
during the night in the barn, she said

answers.why: during 意为“在…期间”，此处引出时间 the long winter（漫长的冬天），说明那件薄薄的托盘是在何时留下的。
during 意为“在…期间”，此处引出处所 the night in the barn（谷仓里的那一夜），说明东西被放在何处。
during 意为“在…期间”，此处引出方式或状态 the silence after supper（晚饭后的安静），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
during 意为“在…期间”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 老护士看护的时候：be tasted during the watch of the old nurse。
during 意为“在…期间”，此处引出原因 the storm（那场风暴），说明整件事由何而起。
during 意为“在…期间”，此处引出对象或目的 the absence of the men（男人们不在的时候）。
during 意为“在…期间”，此处引出工具或材料 the whole journey（整个旅程）。
during 意为“在…期间”，此处引出载体 the meeting of the council（议会开会期间）：names written during the meeting of the council。
during 意为“在…期间”，1967 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件薄薄的托盘，此处仍引出时间 the long winter。
during 意为“在…期间”，母亲 1969 年那句话引出的仍是那一处谷仓里的那一夜。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1957 年漫长的冬天前后，面点师把那件薄薄的托盘留在了炉口。（during the long winter）
那件薄薄的托盘被放在谷仓里的那一夜，谁也没有过问。（during the night in the barn）
整件事是晚饭后的安静做成的，账单上写得明白。（during the silence after supper）
入冬之前，那件薄薄的托盘已经由老护士看护的时候尝过两回。（be tasted during the watch of the old nurse）
叔叔说，整件事是由那场风暴起的。（during the storm）
他说，家里从来没有人为男人们不在的时候做过这件事。（during the absence of the men）
answers: In 1957 the baker kept the tray during the long winter at the oven.
The tray had been left during the night in the barn, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done during the silence after supper, or so the bill says.
The tray had been tasted during the watch of the old nurse twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun during the storm.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it during the absence of the men.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 during 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the baker kept the tray during the long winter, and nobody forgot it.
The tray had been left during the night in the barn for three weeks.
The work was done during the silence after supper, as it always was in those days.
The tray had been tasted during the watch of the old nurse twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the tray during the long winter again when nobody else would.
The whole bakery never forgot what had been done during the night in the barn.
